text:
michael_support: FYI customer BrightArc opened a ticket — their tenant CSV export for 2026-03-10 shows two hourly files of 0 bytes and one CSV row with usage=null. They need this reconciled for invoicing.

sara_ops: can you paste the tenant_id and exact s3 path? any manifest ids?

michael_support: tenant_id=tenant-brightarc-7, manifest s3://ri-exports/tenant-brightarc-7/2026-03-10/manifest.json, customer says manifest lists 24 parts but parts 13 and 14 are 0 bytes. here's customer's snippet: "\"parts\": [{\"hour\":\"12\",\"path\":\".../12.csv.gz\",\"size\":0}, {\"hour\":\"13\",\"path\":\".../13.csv.gz\",\"size\":0}, {\"hour\":\"14\",\"path\":\".../14.csv.gz\",\"size\":10234}]"

deven_billing: quick q — are their invoices dependent on the per-hour CSVs or the aggregated daily ledger? we might be able to reconcile without backfill if ledger has totals.

\michael_support: invoice generated from daily rollup table, but finance wants the CSVs for audit. customer insists updated export file(s).

ingest-bot: [alert] export-worker-7 timed out while uploading part 13 at 2026-03-10T13:02:11Z, error: Write aborted: unexpected EOF

anna_prod: tagging in eng-runtime — likely case where the upload stream closed mid-gzip and the manifest writer still wrote an entry. I've seen this when the worker hit the upload timeout while compressing.

sara_ops: can you confirm if the rollup job ran successfully for those hours? if so we can regenerate the per-hour CSVs from the rollup table.

anna_prod: checked the hourly_rollups table: rows exist for tenant-brightarc-7 for hours 12 and 13 with non-null token_count. so data is present.

anna_prod: repro plan: 1) pull hourly_rollups for tenant and re-generate CSV parts 12/13 2) compress and upload to the same S3 paths, 3) update manifest with new sizes/checksums, 4) mark export as completed.

devon_billing: OK that works. any risk of double-counting if we reupload? need to ensure downstream ledger consumers don't reimport.

anna_prod: we will only write the CSV files and update manifest; downstream importers use manifest etag + processed flag. I'll set the `replay_protect` flag when we touch the export metadata to prevent re-ingest.

michael_support: can you drop the exact commands you'll run so I can tell the customer?

anna_prod: commands (will run from staging job runner):
```
pg_dump -t hourly_rollups --data-only --where "tenant_id='tenant-brightarc-7' AND hour BETWEEN '2026-03-10T12:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-10T13:00:00Z'" > parts.sql
python3 tools/generate_csv_parts.py --input parts.sql --out /tmp/parts
for p in /tmp/parts/*.csv; do gzip -c "$p" | aws s3 cp - s3://ri-exports/tenant-brightarc-7/2026-03-10/$(basename "$p").gz --acl private; done
python3 tools/update_manifest.py --manifest s3://ri-exports/tenant-brightarc-7/2026-03-10/manifest.json --replace parts/12.csv.gz,parts/13.csv.gz --etag-protect
```

anna_prod: will also run a quick checksum compare and set export.metadata.replay_protect=true.

michael_support: ETA to customer?

anna_prod: I can run this in ~40m, finish in 1h. will post logs here.

export-bot: [deploy] export-tooling v2.14 deployed to staging at 2026-03-11T09:12:02Z

sara_ops: please include the upload log & the new manifest json when done. I'll send a reconciliation note to BrightArc and attach the new files.

michael_support: noted. once done I'll confirm with finance that the CSVs attach to their audit and that no ledger reingest happens.

anna_prod: done — re-generated parts 12/13 and uploaded. sample s3 ls output:
```
2026-03-10 12:00  21345 12.csv.gz
2026-03-10 13:00  19876 13.csv.gz
```
new manifest uploaded and replay_protect=true.

anna_prod: logs show original worker error: `Exception: Upload stream closed after 2.1s, timeout threshold 2s` — ops will raise a bug to increase upload timeout for large gzip streams.

michael_support: thanks. Sara, Devon — can one of you take the customer update and include a note about the fix and that we've set replay_protect to avoid double-import?

sara_ops: on it. sending now with attachments. customer replied: "Thanks, this helps for our auditors." :thumbsup:

michael_support: closing ticket after finance confirms. leaving thread open for postmortem on timeout and potential backfill automation.

anna_prod: I'll create a short postmortem PRK and link it here with the logs and the mitigation (increase timeout + retry on gzip flush).

michael_support: perfect, thx all.
